content.value_statement: Job application questions require concise answers that connect your experience to each role. This skill drafts field-specific responses using your CV and the job description.
actual_capabilities: Draft experience and technical-skill answers using real roles, projects, and years of experience.
Connect company-interest answers to relevant candidate experience.
Organize relevant portfolio projects with descriptions, links, and measurable results.
Structure professional introductions and opinion answers for application fields.
Condense behavioral examples into context, actions, and outcomes using the STAR structure.
Provide separately labeled answers with field-specific length guidance and copyable text formatting.
limitations: Provides writing instructions, not browser automation or automatic application submission.
Requires the candidate's CV, job description, and specific questions to produce tailored answers.
Cannot independently verify experience, metrics, links, or company claims from the supplied text.
Does not guarantee hiring outcomes, ATS acceptance, or exact field-limit compliance without review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Role-Specific Answers
use_cases.description: Draft concise experience, motivation, and technical-skill responses for a specific job application.

use_cases.title: Explain Transferable Experience
use_cases.description: Connect adjacent experience to role requirements while stating skill gaps honestly.

use_cases.title: Review Client Application Drafts
use_cases.description: Use a client's supplied CV and questions to prepare evidence-based drafts for their review.

prompt_templates.title: Answer One Question
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my CV [CV] and this job description [JD], answer [question] in two sentences. Ask about any missing facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: draft one short application response.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Company Interest
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an answer to why I want to join [company]. Use [CV], [JD], and [verified company facts]. Keep it under 150 words.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect company details to relevant work.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Behavioral Answer
prompt_templates.prompt: Answer [behavioral question] using [project details], [CV], and [JD]. Use a condensed STAR structure in 150-200 words. Include only supplied metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn project evidence into a behavioral response.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Multiple Application Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft separate labeled answers for [questions and field limits] using [CV], [JD], and [portfolio links]. Prioritize relevant evidence and state experience gaps honestly. Ask for missing facts before drafting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare consistent responses across several application fields.

output_examples.input: CV: three years using Python for internal reporting automation. JD: Python reporting engineer. Question: Describe your Python experience.
output_examples.output: I have three years of Python experience building internal reporting automation. This work directly relates to the reporting focus of this role.

output_examples.input: Project: led a four-person team migrating reporting jobs; added validation and scheduling; reduced weekly manual work by six hours. Question: Describe a project you led.
output_examples.output: I led a four-person team migrating reporting jobs. I added validation checks and scheduling. The project reduced manual work by six hours each week.

output_examples.input: CV: two years building customer support tools. JD: develop tools for support teams. Question: What interests you about this role?
output_examples.output: This role focuses on support tools, which connects directly to my two years building software for customer support. I want to continue working in that domain.

best_practices: Provide the CV, job description, exact questions, and field limits before requesting answers.
Use verified projects, dates, metrics, and links; remove unnecessary personal information before sharing documents.
Review every draft for factual accuracy, relevance, and length before submitting it.
anti_patterns: Inflating years of experience, proficiency ratings, or project results.
Reusing generic company-interest answers without relevant company details.
Adding unrelated projects or lengthy cover-letter text to short application fields.

faq.question: Does this skill fill forms in a browser?
faq.answer: No. It drafts text for application fields. You must review and enter the answers yourself.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your CV, the job description, exact application questions, and any word or character limits.

faq.question: Which application platforms can use these answers?
faq.answer: The instructions mention Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workday. The generated text can also be used in other application forms.

faq.question: Can it help when I lack a required skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can explain relevant adjacent experience and acknowledge gaps without inflating your qualifications.

faq.question: Can it answer several questions together?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the assistant to provide a separate labeled answer for each field.

faq.question: Does it verify my experience or guarantee interviews?
faq.answer: No. It relies on supplied information and provides writing guidance. You remain responsible for accuracy and final submission.
